name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '0d' is spell id 0xD (= 治療術/Cure, a heal spell; spell IDs are domain values 00h-23h) -- a meaningful domain ID that must be preserved, not an address residue. 'variant_b' correctly distinguishes the heal-style dispatch path (fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast -> fd2_apply_heal_spell_to_target) from the offensive-A family. Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Battle spell-dispatch entry for spell_id 0xD (治療術/Cure heal spell): plays the status-effect SFX then a variant-B slide pre-cast effect, then hands off to the variant-B heal worker.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr, 0xB, 1) to play status-effect SFX id 0xB; calls fd2_play_variant_b_slide_pre_effect(1, 2) for the pre-cast slide animation; then calls fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast(caster, 0xD, n_tgt, tgt_arr) which runs per-target impact + status-overlay animation, deducts caster MP, applies fd2_apply_heal_spell_to_target per target and shows the heal number. Also serves as the shared-tail anchor (alt-entry at 0x21B0B) for sibling spell ids 0xE/0xF/0x10. Cyclomatic complexity 1 (straight-line). Leading __CHK(0x14,...) is the Watcom stack-probe, not game logic.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_0d_variant_b(int caster, int n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; forwarded unchanged to fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast (param_1).
params.reason: Descriptive, ASCII, no address residue; matches actual use (passed through as caster).

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of targets; forwarded unchanged to the dispatch worker (param_3, loop bound).
params.reason: Descriptive, ASCII, no address residue; matches actual use (target count).

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target-id array; cast to int and forwarded to the dispatch worker (param_4), indexed per target inside the heal loop.
params.reason: Descriptive, ASCII, no address residue; matches actual use (target id array base).

returns.semantics: No return value; dispatch entry that delegates to the variant-B heal worker.

comment_original_issue: Function had no per-function comment; only the family header at line 120 covered it. Siblings 0xB/0xC (same in-file convention) each carry a per-function comment with their distinctive SFX id + pre-effect params, but the variant-B entries (0xD-0x10) did not, so 0xD's specific SFX/pre-effect params and heal identity were not documented.
notes: Spell identity confirmed via fd2-knowledge: spell 0Dh = 治療術 (heal/recovery). Heal path confirmed by decompiling worker fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast @ 0x21B18 (uses fd2_apply_heal_spell_to_target, shows damage number with indicator 0x69='i'). Sole xref to this function is DATA @ 0x51D35 (spell dispatch table @ 0x51D01 + 0x34 = entry index 0xD); no direct CALL callers (table-driven). Ghidra plate is detailed, accurate, and consistent with refined understanding -- left unchanged. No logic touched.
